skill_name: Generate a story about a town coming together to help someone in need.
workflow:
When Rita's family had fallen on hard times, their small town rallied around them in their time of need. People from all walks of life helped out in whatever ways they could, people from different churches and charities coming together to serve in a unified way. 

No one ever went hungry in Rita's neighborhood, as neighbors brought cooked food over and local businesses set up a donation program to offset their living expenses. The town also organized fund-raising drives to pay for needed medical
